mapper.sql: id, permission_name, permission_code, api_path, api_method, description, status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_name, permission_code, api_path, api_method, description, status) VALUES (#{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{apiPath}, #{apiMethod}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE p.api_path = #{apiPath} AND p.api_method = #{apiMethod} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1

SELECT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.api_path, p.api_method, p.description, p.status FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1

SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1
AND permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionName}, '%')
AND api_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiPath}, '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1
AND permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionName}, '%')
AND api_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiPath}, '%')

SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1
AND permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{permissionName}, '%')
AND api_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{apiPath}, '%')
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
